Name: DIRECTION_CAMERA_PARAM_ST
Description: Settings for direction cameras (scripted camera effects that steer the view at set moments), looked up by the camera effect's ID.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Follows Camera Option
Fields.Description: If ON, this camera effect is affected by the direction camera ON/OFF option in the game settings and does not play while the option is off. If OFF, the effect always plays.
